description: Schedules a wakeup 90 seconds out (ScheduleWakeup) and ends its turn, so the chat waits on a timer with no background task. The sidebar shows it parked, not idle, until the wake fires (a plain echo reply) or Stop cancels it.

steps.text: I'll check back on the build in a minute and a half.
